entities.label: SPRUJ26A
entities.description: Motor Control SDK Universal Project and Lab User's Guide, Rev. A (September 2021, revised April 2024).
aliases: Universal Motor Control Project and Lab User's Guide

entities.label: Universal Motor Control Lab
entities.description: Universal example lab project in the C2000Ware MotorControl SDK supporting various TI EVM motor driver kits with F280025C, F280039C or F2800137 devices.

entities.label: C2000Ware MotorControl SDK
entities.description: C2000WARE-MOTORCONTROL-SDK software package; installable from its tools folder or via CCS Resource Explorer.

entities.label: Code Composer Studio
entities.description: TI IDE used to import, build, load and debug the lab; version 10.4 or above recommended.

entities.label: TI Resource Explorer
entities.description: CCS view (View -> Resource Explorer) from which the C2000Ware MotorControl SDK can be installed.

entities.label: CCS Graph Tool
entities.description: Graph tool in CCS that displays arrays of data in device memory in various graphical types; used with DATALOG.

entities.label: CCS Expressions Window
entities.description: CCS watch view (View -> Expressions) used to watch and set variables; variable groups can be imported from universal_lab_levelN.txt files.

entities.label: C2000Ware
entities.description: C2000Ware driverlib on which the device peripheral configuration of the project is based.

entities.label: F280025C
entities.description: C2000 MCU device supported by the universal lab.

entities.label: F280039C
entities.description: C2000 MCU device supported by the universal lab.

entities.label: F2800137
entities.description: C2000 MCU device supported by the universal lab.

entities.label: F28002x
entities.description: Device family with project universal_motorcontrol_lab_f28002x.

entities.label: F28003x
entities.description: Device family with project universal_motorcontrol_lab_f28003x.

entities.label: F280013x
entities.description: Device family with project universal_motorcontrol_lab_f280013x; has only one SPI module shared between BoosterPack sites 1 and 2.

entities.label: C2000
entities.description: TI C2000 MCU platform.

entities.label: BOOSTXL-DRV8323RS
entities.description: Motor driver BoosterPack used with the LaunchPads to show how to import and run the lab.

entities.label: LAUNCHXL-F280025C
entities.description: LaunchPad used with BOOSTXL-DRV8323RS to demonstrate the example lab.

entities.label: LAUNCHXL-F280039C
entities.description: LaunchPad used with BOOSTXL-DRV8323RS to demonstrate the example lab.

entities.label: LAUNCHXL-F2800137
entities.description: LaunchPad used with BOOSTXL-DRV8323RS to demonstrate the example lab.

entities.label: TMDSCNCD280025C
entities.description: controlCARD; TMS320F280025C.ccxml is its target configuration.

entities.label: DRV8329AEVM
entities.description: Motor driver kit listed in the supporting algorithms/functions matrix (Table 3-4).

entities.label: BOOSTXL-DRV8323RH
entities.description: Motor driver kit listed in the supporting algorithms/functions matrix (Table 3-4).

entities.label: DRV8353RS-EVM
entities.description: Motor driver kit listed in the supporting algorithms/functions matrix (Table 3-4).

entities.label: BOOSTXL-3PHGANINV
entities.description: Motor driver kit listed in the supporting algorithms/functions matrix (Table 3-4).

entities.label: DRV8316REVM
entities.description: Motor driver kit listed in the supporting algorithms/functions matrix (Table 3-4).

entities.label: TMDSHVMTRINSPIN
entities.description: High voltage motor kit; the only kit supporting PWMDAC since it has extra PWM outputs with RC filters on board; does not support external DAC128S.

entities.label: DAC128S085EVM
entities.description: External 8-channel, 12-bit DAC evaluation board driven over SPI to view software variables on an oscilloscope.

entities.label: SPI
entities.description: Serial peripheral used to transmit DAC128S data to the DAC128S085EVM.

entities.label: LVSERVOMTR
entities.description: Low-voltage servo motor supported by FAST, eSMO, encoder and Hall based FOC in Table 3-4.

entities.label: LVBLDCMTR
entities.description: Low-voltage BLDC motor supported on DRV8329AEVM and with Hall sensored FOC (Table 3-4).

entities.label: HVPMSMMTR
entities.description: High-voltage PMSM used with TMDSHVMTRINSPIN for FAST, eSMO and encoder FOC (Table 3-4).

entities.label: HVBLDCMTR
entities.description: High-voltage BLDC motor used with TMDSHVMTRINSPIN for Hall sensored FOC (Table 3-4).

entities.label: FOC
entities.description: Field-oriented control; the lab supports FAST/eSMO sensorless and encoder/Hall sensored FOC.

entities.label: FAST
entities.description: InstaSPIN-FOC FAST estimator for sensorless FOC; outputs flux, angle, speed and torque and supports motor identification.

entities.label: eSMO
entities.description: Enhanced Sliding Mode Observer with PLL for sensorless FOC.

entities.label: PLL
entities.description: Phase-locked loop used with eSMO.

entities.label: InstaSPIN-FOC
entities.description: Library in src_lib containing FAST.

entities.label: InstaSPIN-BLDC
entities.description: Trapezoidal BLDC control library (MOTOR1_ISBLDC); cannot be combined with other estimators.

entities.label: Clarke transform
entities.description: Clarke transformation for current or voltage (CLARKE_run).

entities.label: Park transform
entities.description: Park transformation (PARK_run).

entities.label: Inverse Park transform
entities.description: Inverse Park transformation (IPARK_run).

entities.label: SVPWM
entities.description: Space vector PWM with quadrature control (SVGEN_run); common or minimum SVM mode selectable.

entities.label: PI controller
entities.description: PI regulators for current and speed (PI_run).

entities.label: MTPA
entities.description: Maximum torque per ampere, run in the ISR and evaluated in level 4.

entities.label: Field weakening control
entities.description: Field weakening control (FWC), enabled by MOTOR1_FWC symbol.

entities.label: V/f control
entities.description: Scalar open-loop voltage/frequency control used in build level 2.

entities.label: I/f control
entities.description: Current closed-loop control with the rotor angle from the ramp generator, used in build level 3.

entities.label: Encoder
entities.description: QEP encoder used for sensored FOC (ENC_run, SPDCALC_run).

entities.label: Hall sensor
entities.description: Hall sensors used for sensored FOC (HALL_run).

entities.label: IPD
entities.description: Initial position detection, run in the motor control ISR.

entities.label: Rotor angle
entities.description: Rotor flux angle estimated by FAST/eSMO or measured by encoder/Hall.

entities.label: Motor speed
entities.description: Motor speed feedback.

entities.label: Predefined symbols
entities.description: Project property pre-define symbols that enable/disable functions; a symbol is disabled by appending _N (e.g. MOTOR1_FWC_N).

entities.label: MOTOR1_FAST
entities.description: Enables FAST based sensorless FOC.

entities.label: MOTOR1_ESMO
entities.description: Enables eSMO based sensorless FOC.

entities.label: MOTOR1_ENC
entities.description: Enables QEP encoder based sensored FOC (with QEP_ENABLE).

entities.label: QEP_ENABLE
entities.description: Symbol for QEP encoder based sensored FOC.

entities.label: MOTOR1_HALL
entities.description: Enables Hall sensors based sensored FOC (with HALL_ENABLE, HALL_CAL).

entities.label: HALL_ENABLE
entities.description: Symbol for Hall sensor based sensored FOC.

entities.label: HALL_CAL
entities.description: Symbol for Hall sensor calibration in Hall sensored FOC.

entities.label: MOTOR1_ISBLDC
entities.description: Enables trapezoidal InstaSPIN-BLDC; supported only on DRV8329AEVM per Table 3-4.

entities.label: MOTOR1_FWC
entities.description: Enables field weakening control for motor 1; MOTOR1_FWC_N disables it.

entities.label: MOTOR1_DCLINK_SS
entities.description: Enables single-shunt current sensing; supported only on DRV8329AEVM per Table 3-4.

entities.label: DATALOGF2_EN
entities.description: Enables Datalog with graph tool; requires DMA.

entities.label: EPWMDAC_MODE
entities.description: Enables PWMDAC function; supported only on TMDSHVMTRINSPIN.

entities.label: DAC_128S_ENABLE
entities.description: Enables external DAC128S functionality (written DAC128S_ENABLE in Table 3-4).

entities.label: SFRA_ENABLE
entities.description: Enables SFRA tool.

entities.label: STEP_RP_EN
entities.description: Enables step response with graph tool.

entities.label: TEST_ENABLE
entities.description: Predefine required for ISRCount to increment.

entities.label: Single-shunt current sensing
entities.description: Single-shunt current sense; supported on DRV8329AEVM.

entities.label: DATALOG
entities.description: Module storing real-time values of two user-selectable variables in C2000 data RAM via DMA for display with the graph tool.

entities.label: PWMDAC
entities.description: Converts software variables into PWM signals on ePWM6A/6B/7A/7B, viewed through external RC low-pass filters.

entities.label: DAC128S module
entities.description: Converts up to 8 software variables to 12-bit values and sends them over SPI to the DAC128S085EVM.

entities.label: SFRA
entities.description: Software frequency response analyzer tool; SFRA specific files are in the project.

entities.label: Step response with graph tool
entities.description: Step response function shown with the graph tool.

entities.label: DMA
entities.description: Direct Memory Access; used to transfer selected variables to the datalog buffers in RAM.

entities.label: ePWM
entities.description: PWM peripheral; drives the motor and the PWMDAC outputs.

entities.label: RC low-pass filter
entities.description: First-order RC filter required to view PWMDAC signals; time constant tau = RC = 1/(2*pi*fc).

entities.label: DATA_LOG_SCALE_FACTOR
entities.description: Datalog prescaler define in datalogIF.h; default 10 (logs one of every N samples).

entities.label: datalogObj->iptr[0..1]
entities.description: Datalog module inputs pointed to addresses of the two logged variables; set in sys_main.c and vary by build level.

entities.label: datalogBuff1
entities.description: Datalog RAM buffer arrays (with datalogBuff2) holding logged data for display.

entities.label: DAC_EN_CH_NUM
entities.description: Define in dac128s085.h setting number of DAC128S outputs (1-8); default 4.

entities.label: dac128s.ptrData[0..7]
entities.description: DAC128S module inputs pointing to variables (angles, currents, voltages), with gain[] and offset[]; set in sys_main.c by build level.

entities.label: pwmDACData.ptrData[0..3]
entities.description: PWMDAC module inputs pointing to four variables, with offset[] and gain[]; set in sys_main.c.

entities.label: sys_main.c
entities.description: System main file; initializes DATALOG, PWMDAC and DAC128S objects and their input pointers; holds userParams_M1.flag_bypassMotorId.

entities.label: sys_settings.h
entities.description: Build level setting file; DMC_BUILDLEVEL is set here.

entities.label: motor1_drive.c
entities.description: Motor drive control specific file containing motor1ctrlISR() which updates datalog, PWMDAC and DAC128S.

entities.label: motor_comm.c
entities.description: Motor drive common functions file.

entities.label: hal.c
entities.description: Board-specific hardware abstraction layer drivers; with hal.h, the files to change when migrating to a custom board or other C2000 device.

entities.label: hal.h
entities.description: HAL header with board-specific definitions.

entities.label: user_mtr1.h
entities.description: Board and motor parameters definition file in src_board; motor defines section begins on line 921.

entities.label: user_mtr1.c
entities.description: Board and motor specific parameters source file.

entities.label: user_common.h
entities.description: Common user definitions file used with user_mtr1.h to select or define the motor model.

entities.label: drv83xx.c
entities.description: Inverter gate driver file.

entities.label: datalogIF.h
entities.description: Datalog interface header defining DATA_LOG_SCALE_FACTOR.

entities.label: datalogIF.c
entities.description: Datalog interface source declaring DATALOG_Obj datalog and handle.

entities.label: dac128s085.h
entities.description: DAC128S085 driver header defining DAC_EN_CH_NUM.

entities.label: motor_datalog_fp2.graphProp
entities.description: Graph configuration file in common\debug importable via Tools -> Graph -> DualTime.

entities.label: universal_lab_levelN.txt
entities.description: Expression variable lists (universal_lab_level1..4.txt) in common\debug imported into the Expressions window per build level.

entities.label: Target configuration file (.ccxml)
entities.description: Debugger target configuration, e.g. TMS320F280025C_LaunchPad.ccxml for LAUNCHXL-F280025C and TMS320F280025C.ccxml for TMDSCNCD280025C.

entities.label: src_foc
entities.description: Folder with FOC modules (Park, Clarke, inverse transforms, PID, estimators) independent of device/board.

entities.label: src_lib
entities.description: Folder with the InstaSPIN-FOC library and math library.

entities.label: src_control
entities.description: Folder with motor drive control files calling core algorithm functions within ISRs and background tasks.

entities.label: src_sys
entities.description: Folder reserved for user system control, communication, etc.

entities.label: src_board
entities.description: Folder with board-, motor- and device-specific files (hal.c, hal.h, user_mtr1.h).

entities.label: motor1ctrlISR()
entities.description: Motor control ISR triggered by ADC end of conversion; reads ADC, runs Clarke, estimators, speed/current loops, IPD/FWC/MTPA, I-Park, SVGEN and PWM.

entities.label: ADC
entities.description: ADC; its end of conversion (EOC) triggers the motor control ISR.

entities.label: CMPSS
entities.description: Comparator subsystem implementing over current protection.

entities.label: Over current protection
entities.description: Over current fault disables PWM, clears flagEnableRunAndIdentify and sets faultMtrUse.all to 0x10.

entities.label: Motor parameter identification
entities.description: FAST-based identification of Rs, Ls_d, Ls_q and rated flux; takes about 150 s; can also run online without reloading code.

entities.label: ANGLE_GEN_run
entities.description: Ramp angle generator for open-loop running.

entities.label: CLARKE_run
entities.description: Clarke transformation for current or voltage.

entities.label: DAC128S_writeData
entities.description: Converts and sends software variables to external DAC with SPI.

entities.label: DATALOGIF_update
entities.description: Stores real-time values for displaying with graph tool.

entities.label: ENC_run
entities.description: Calculates rotor angle based on encoder.

entities.label: ESMO_run
entities.description: Enhanced Sliding Mode Observer for sensorless FOC.

entities.label: EST_run
entities.description: FAST estimator for sensorless FOC.

entities.label: EST_runTraj
entities.description: Trajectory generator for current and speed for motor identification (FAST).

entities.label: EST_setupTrajState
entities.description: Trajectory generator setup for current and speed for motor identification (FAST).

entities.label: HAL_readADCData
entities.description: Returns ADC conversion values in floating-point format.

entities.label: HAL_writePWMDACData
entities.description: Converts software variables into PWM signals.

entities.label: HAL_writePWMData
entities.description: PWM drives for motor.

entities.label: HALL_run
entities.description: Calculates rotor angle and speed based on Hall sensors.

entities.label: IPARK_run
entities.description: Inverse Park transformation.

entities.label: PARK_run
entities.description: Park transformation.

entities.label: PI_run
entities.description: PI regulators for current and speed.

entities.label: SPDCALC_run
entities.description: Speed measurement based on encoder angle.

entities.label: SPDFR_run
entities.description: Speed measurement based on observer angle (eSMO).

entities.label: SVGEN_run
entities.description: Space vector PWM with quadrature control.

entities.label: TRAJ_run
entities.description: Trajectory for setting speed reference.

entities.label: VS_FREQ_run
entities.description: Generates vector voltage with v/f profile.

entities.label: DMC_BUILDLEVEL
entities.description: Define in sys_settings.h selecting DMC_LEVEL_1..DMC_LEVEL_4; rebuild project after change.

entities.label: Build Level 1
entities.description: DMC_LEVEL_1: open-loop 50% PWM duty with motor disconnected; verifies HAL peripheral init, PWM and ADC drivers, ADC offset calibration.

entities.label: Build Level 2
entities.description: DMC_LEVEL_2: open-loop scalar v/f control validating current/voltage sensing, gate driver, and FAST or eSMO estimators.

entities.label: Build Level 3
entities.description: DMC_LEVEL_3: closed current loop (i/f) with angle from ramp generator; verifies current sensing parameters.

entities.label: Build Level 4
entities.description: DMC_LEVEL_4: speed and current closed loop with FAST/eSMO/encoder/Hall angle; motor identification with FAST and features such as FWC, flying start, MTPA, braking.

entities.label: ADC offset calibration
entities.description: Calibration of phase current/voltage offsets; current offsets near 2048 (half 12-bit scale), voltage offset coefficients about 0.5.

entities.label: Flying start
entities.description: Additional feature evaluated in build level 4.

entities.label: Braking
entities.description: Additional feature evaluated in build level 4.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.flagEnableRunAndIdentify
entities.description: Set to 1 to run the motor / identification, 0 to stop and disable PWMs.

entities.label: systemVars.flagEnableSystem
entities.description: Set to 1 automatically after offset calibration completes.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.flagRunIdentAndOnLine
entities.description: Set to 1 automatically if there are no faults.

entities.label: ISRCount
entities.description: Increments continuously when TEST_ENABLE is defined.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.faultMtrPrev.bit
entities.description: Fault flag structure checked for no faults.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.faultMtrUse.all
entities.description: Fault flags; should be 0; set to 0x10 on over current fault.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.speedRef_Hz
entities.description: Speed reference for the motor; negative value for reverse rotation.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.speed_Hz
entities.description: Motor speed; should be close to speedRef_Hz.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.overCurrent_A
entities.description: Over current protection threshold; decreasing below phase current triggers fault.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.svmMode
entities.description: SVM mode selection: SVM_COM_C (common) or SVM_MIN_C (minimum).

entities.label: motorVars_M1.Idq_set_A.value[1]
entities.description: Reference torque current set in build level 3.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.adcData.current_sf
entities.description: Current scale factor whose sign must match hardware board; related to USER_M1_ADC_FULL_SCALE_CURRENT_A.

entities.label: userParams_M1.current_sf
entities.description: User current scale factor related to USER_M1_ADC_FULL_SCALE_CURRENT_A.

entities.label: userParams_M1.flag_bypassMotorId
entities.description: In sys_main.c; false enables motor identification, true disables it.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.flagEnableMotorIdentify
entities.description: Set to 1 to enable online identification without reloading code.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.accelerationMax_Hzps
entities.description: Sets the acceleration.

entities.label: motorSetVars_M1.Kp_Id
entities.description: Current controller gains (also Ki_Id, Kp_Iq, Ki_Iq) calculated in setupControllers() and tunable.

entities.label: motorSetVars_M1.Kp_spd
entities.description: Speed controller gains (also Ki_spd) calculated in setupControllers(); a starting reference for tuning.

entities.label: systemVars.estType
entities.description: Indicates enabled estimator combination: EST_TYPE_FAST_ESMO, EST_TYPE_FAST_ENC, EST_TYPE_FAST_HALL, EST_TYPE_ESMO_ENC.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.estimatorMode
entities.description: Selects estimator in use (ESTIMATOR_MODE_FAST/ESMO/ENC/HALL); can be switched on the fly.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.angleGen_rad
entities.description: Angle from the force angle generator; monitored vs estimator angle.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.angleEST_rad
entities.description: Estimated rotor angle from FAST or eSMO.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.adcData.I_A.value[]
entities.description: Phase current samples; default datalog inputs.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.adcData.V_V.value[]
entities.description: Phase voltage samples.

entities.label: setupControllers()
entities.description: Function calculating default Kp and Ki for current and speed controllers.

entities.label: Simultaneous dual estimators
entities.description: Two FOC algorithms can be used simultaneously (FAST+eSMO, FAST+ENC, FAST+HALL, eSMO+ENC) and switched smoothly on the fly; ISBLDC cannot be combined.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_FREQ_LOW_HZ
entities.description: v/f profile low frequency.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_FREQ_HIGH_HZ
entities.description: v/f profile high frequency.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_VOLT_MIN_V
entities.description: v/f profile minimum voltage.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_VOLT_MAX_V
entities.description: v/f profile maximum voltage.

entities.label: USER_M1_PWM_FREQ_kHz
entities.description: PWM switching frequency define.

entities.label: USER_M1_ADC_FULL_SCALE_CURRENT_A
entities.description: ADC full-scale current; used in DAC gains and current scale factors.

entities.label: USER_M1_ADC_FULL_SCALE_VOLTAGE_V
entities.description: ADC full-scale voltage; used in DAC128S gains.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_OVER_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Motor over current value; used in PWMDAC gain scaling.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_TYPE
entities.description: Motor type.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_NUM_POLE_PAIRS
entities.description: Number of pole pairs.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_Rr_Ohm
entities.description: Rotor resistance.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_Rs_Ohm
entities.description: Stator resistance; replaced with identified motorSetVars_M1.Rs_Ohm.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_Ls_d_H
entities.description: d-axis inductance; replaced with identified motorSetVars_M1.Ls_d_H.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_Ls_q_H
entities.description: q-axis inductance; replaced with identified motorSetVars_M1.Ls_q_H.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_RATED_FLUX_VpHz
entities.description: Rated flux; replaced with identified motorSetVars_M1.flux_VpHz.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_RES_EST_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Identification current for resistance estimation, 10~30% of rated current.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_IND_EST_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Identification current for inductance estimation, 10~30% of rated current, enough to rotate.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_MAX_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Max current, 30~150% of rated current.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_FLUX_EXC_FREQ_Hz
entities.description: Flux excitation frequency for identification, 10~30% of rated frequency.
